title: Elementary parameter-root boundary and profinite-test maps
statement:
Let $p\in\mathbf N$, let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $r\in\mathbf N$ and let $t:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to R$. Put $N_p=\{n\in\mathbf N:0<n,\ \gcd(n,p)=1\}$. Use the compatible-root algebra construction of [def-sfb-strict-local-kummer-tame-module], here with arbitrary $R,p,t$: explicitly, using [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] and [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient],
$$A=\operatorname{tameRootAlgebra}(p,t)=R[x_{i,n}:i\in\operatorname{Fin}(r),\ n\in N_p]/J,$$
where $J$ is generated by $x_{i,n}^{n}-t_i$ and $x_{i,m}^{m/n}-x_{i,n}$ for $n,m\in N_p$ with $n\mid m$. Put $I=(t_i:i\in\operatorname{Fin}(r))$ and $\bar R=R/I$. Define $\varepsilon:A\to\bar R$ by $\varepsilon([F])=\bar F(0)$: reduce coefficients modulo $I$ and set every root variable to zero. This is well-defined since the displayed relations evaluate to zero ($n>0$ and $m/n>0$), and is an $R$-algebra homomorphism. Using affine spectra [def-weil-affine-spectrum], define $T=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $U=\operatorname{Spec}R$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}\bar R$, $q:T\to U$ from the structure homomorphism, $s:S\to U$ from the quotient map and $i=\operatorname{Spec}(\varepsilon):S\to T$. For a profinite set $P$ use the actual test scheme $X[P]=\operatorname{Spec}\operatorname{LC}(P,\mathbf Z)\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z}X$ and projection $\pi_{X,P}:X[P]\to X$ of [def-sfb-profinite-test-objects]. For $f:X\to Y$, define $f[P]:X[P]\to Y[P]$ by the unique fibre-product lift [def-pc-fibre-product] with parameter component unchanged and scheme component $f\circ\pi_{X,P}$. Define $q_P=q\circ\pi_{T,P}$. These constructions include $r=0$, empty $P$ and the zero ring. They specify the elementary boundary and test maps only; no derived comparison or integral, lisse, or coordinate-face base-change assertion is included.
